messages:
Maya Rao: quick sync — Enterprise deal (OrionCorp) requested committed runbook + cost delta. They projected 90k DAU, ~3 chats/user/day, heavy peak windows 4x baseline. Need 99p <350ms and a fallback model for capacity shortage. @Ethan can you sketch options?
Ethan Cole: sure. need average tokens per message and preferred model. assuming 50 tokens/msg, peak rps target ~600. two high-level options: latency-first or cost-optimized.
Priya Singh: infra notes — for 600peak rps (50 tokens) on rw-chat-large:
- Latency-first: 7x A100-80GB reserved, autoscale min=2, burst pool +3 spot. target util 60-70%. expect 99p ~320ms with kv-cache warm.
- Cost-first: 5x A100 reserved + int8 quantized variant, autoscale min=1, burst pool +2. expected 99p ~420ms unless we add prewarm.
Marco Li: pricing ballpark (internal): 7x reserved ≈ $70k/mo committed, 5x ≈ $48k/mo. Dedicated SLA addon +$7k/mo. For PoC we can offer a 2-week 50% list pilot on 5x reserved.
Maya Rao: security ask from legal: VPC peering, bring-your-own-key (KMS), monthly audit logs, SOC2 + penetration test attestation. Also require a short failover playbook for fallback model.
Ethan Cole: KV-cache warmup: with their session churn profile expect ~8-12 minutes to reach 90% warmth for most hot prefixes. Cold start queue behavior: default queue depth 150, can extend to 300 with burst credits. Scale cooldown 90s, can be reduced to 45s for PoC if they accept oscillation risk.
Priya Singh: will attach a lightweight load harness for SRE to run smoke tests. simple bash loop + concurrency controller. example: 
```
for i in {1..2000}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/chat \ 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
    -d '{"model":"rw-chat-large","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}],"max_tokens":80}' &
  sleep 0.005
done
```
Marco Li: I'll prepare the PoC quote and a short comparison table (reserved vs metered) and drop in Sales Kit.
ops-bot: Reminder: reserve-pool adjustments need 72h lead time for guaranteed AZ capacity. Submit infra-ops ticket.
Maya Rao: plan: 1) Ethan/Priya validate perf sims and post numbers by EOD tomorrow; 2) Marco to send pilot quote; 3) I'll draft the failover playbook and presales slide. Any blockers?
Ethan Cole: none from eng, will run sims.
Priya Singh: no blockers, will post harness and initial numbers.
Marco Li: sending quote today.
Maya Rao: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll sync with OrionCorp on Thursday and include the warmup/runway numbers in the call.
